entities.summary: Carole A. Feuerman is an American sculptor and author renowned for her superrealist art. She is recognized as one of the pioneering artists of the superrealism movement in the late 1970s and is best known for her figurative works of swimmers and dancers. Feuerman utilizes a variety of mediums including resin, marble, and bronze.
